messages.text:
Hello Helium D. Team,

I am participating in your giveaway from India.

Unfortunately, TikTok is banned in India, so I cannot complete the
TikTok-related entry task.

I am very interested in your giveaway and would love to participate.

Could you please provide an alternative task or another way to earn this
entry?

I hope participants from India can also have an equal opportunity to
participate.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards, Rahul I.
Handed to the team · Giveaway rules and alternative entries aren't in the product facts or team guida

Hi Rahul,

Thanks for entering the giveaway. You're right that TikTok being banned in India shouldn't stop you from taking part.

I can't set up an alternative entry task myself, so I've passed your request to the team. They're offline for the weekend and will pick it up when they're back on Monday. Their answer will come to you in this email thread, and you don't need to send anything again.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
